shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc 'pwd && cat ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then cat ../round-brief.md; fi && cat .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,130p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\" && sed -n '1,160p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npm ls ajv @types/ajv --depth=1 && node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json'); console.log(p.types,p.typings,p.exports)\" && rg 'interface Options|instancePath|dataPath' node_modules/ajv/lib node_modules/ajv/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -30 && cat tsconfig.json"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts && cat package.json | sed -n '1,120p' && git log -3 --oneline"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'node_modules/ajv|\"ajv\"' package-lock.json | head -20 && sed -n '1360,1390p' package-lock.json && git show HEAD"'^:package.json | rg -n '"'ajv|version' | head"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '4890,4920p' package-lock.json && git diff HEAD"'^ -- package-lock.json | head -100 && git status --porcelain=v1'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -l 'declare module [\"\\x27]ajv|class Ajv' node_modules/@types node_modules -g '*.d.ts' | head -30 && sed -n '1,100p' jest.config.js && rg -n 'moduleNameMapper|ajv' jest.config* src -g '*.ts'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Handle AJV validation error paths" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
